questions.title: Film Club - Part 1

metadata.scenario:
You are a new member of a film club. Fill in the form. Write in sentences. Use 20 – 30 words.
Please write some of your favorite films and why you like watching them.

questions.stem: You are a member of a film club. You are talking to three other members in the food club chat room. Talk to them using sentences. Use 30 – 40 words.

questions.prompt: Hi. Welcome to the club. How often do you watch films?
questions.sample_answer: I’m a student, so I only have free time on weekends. On Sundays, I like to spend the whole day watching movies to unwind and recharge.

questions.prompt: Hi. Can you remember the first film that you watched? What was it like?
questions.sample_answer:
The first film I watched was Titanic, which beautifully portrays the romance between Jack and Rose until tragedy struck and the ship sank, separating them forever.

Or

As far as I can remember, the first film I watched was Doraemon, my all-time favorite cartoon. It tells the story of a robotic cat named Doraemon and a boy, Nobita Nobi, teaching many valuable life lessons.

questions.prompt: What would you like to learn from the film club?
questions.sample_answer:
I hope to gain a better understanding of film production and enjoy memorable moments with other club members. Watching famous films and making new friends would also be exciting.
Or
I’d like to learn about various kinds of films and explore more exciting movies. As a club member, I can also exchange knowledge and share my passion for films with others.

questions.title: Film Club - Part 3

questions.stem: Read the email and complete the two tasks.

metadata.context: YOU ARE A MEMBER OF A FILM CLUB. YOU RECEIVED THIS EMAIL FROM THE CLUB.

email.body: We are writing to tell you that the guest actor, James Mc Avoy, will unfortunately not be able to give a talk at our next club meeting due to personal reasons. He has requested we reschedule the talk for the next year in either January or March. Please contact the club secretary if you have a preference for one of the two months. Our meeting will take place as usual with a discussion on the advantages and disadvantages of learning on the Internet.
